values.description: FacilityService HTTP endpoint. Verified from src/Services/FacilityService/SmartParking.FacilityService.API/Properties/launchSettings.json (profile `http`) and scripts that launch the service.
UserService. Used only to obtain bearer tokens; the FacilityService calls it for owner/operator scope. No Facility route exposes it.
Reservation/OperationService. Required by every structure mutation (commitment hold), GET /structure, GET /operator-layout (snapshot) and POST /operations (impact plan).

Seeded demo Owner (SMARTPARK_OWNER_EMAIL). Holds BUSINESS_OWNER, so owner-scope grants PARKING_MANAGE and BACKUP_CONFIGURE. It does NOT hold BACKUP_MARK: that permission must be granted explicitly (DEC-LOT-04), so 5.16/5.17 expect 403 FORBIDDEN.
Copy SMARTPARK_OWNER_PASSWORD from the repository root .env. Never commit the real value.
Seeded demo Operator (SMARTPARK_OPERATOR_EMAIL); scripts/seed-demo-site.ps1 assigns it to the demo site with SLOT_OVERRIDE.
Copy SMARTPARK_OPERATOR_PASSWORD from the repository root .env. Never commit the real value.
Seeded demo Driver (DataSeeder). Used only by the operator-layout authorization case.
Seeded demo driver password, already public in the repository source.
Seeded demo Admin (SMARTPARK_ADMIN_EMAIL). Optional; kept for parity with the SPARK-228 collection.
Copy SMARTPARK_ADMIN_PASSWORD from the repository root .env. Never commit the real value.
